tasks.label: check-admin
args: $isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator); if (-not $isAdmin) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'ERROR: VSCode must run as Administrator to debug keyflow' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host 'Please close VSCode and restart it as Administrator' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; exit 1 } else { Write-Host 'Running as Administrator - OK' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }

tasks.label: kill-keyflow
args: while ($true) { $procs = Get-Process -Name keyflow -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $procs) { break }; $procs | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200 }; exit 0
